sources.title: Llama 3.1 8B: How to Run It Locally with 128K Context
sources.snippet: Meta Llama 3.1 8B Advanced Local Deployment Guide Meta's Llama 3.1 8B is the smallest model in the 2024 refresh yet keeps 128K context, tool use, and multilingual support. It delivers GPT-4-class reasoning at a fraction of the VRAM footprint, making it one of the most accessible LLMs you can run locally for local builders.

sources.title: Llama 3.1 | meta-llama/llama-models | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: Llama 3.1 is a collection of multilingual large language models available in three sizes: 8B, 70B, and 405B parameters. All variants use an optimized transformer architecture with Grouped-Query Attention (GQA) for improved inference scalability.
